short_description.description: Brief character subtitle or card description.

core_identity.description: Stable role, identity, and relationship premise.

personality.description: Baseline temperament, traits, motivations, and emotional range.

background.description: History, formative context, secrets, obligations, or important past events.

speech_style.description: Voice, diction, pacing, habits, and dialogue style.

scenario.description: Opening situation or recurring premise for chats.

behavior_instructions.description: Roleplay behavior rules. Should include not speaking or acting for the user.

drift_guardrails.description: Rules that keep the character grounded in the original baseline.

first_message.description: Optional first in-character message or scene opener.
